doc: Weights of the three cell textures at 28 hand-picked (lat, back-traced lat) pairs, radians in, Hadley edge 30: equator, the street peak x=0.55, closed decks, partly and fully cold air, the point where closed+open+street exceeds 1 before the normalization (34.75 deg with 5 deg of poleward back-trace, both hemispheres), air from equatorward, and the two poles. Closed form in float64: 1e-9 (measured against a scalar math-module evaluation: bit-identical to a math-module scalar evaluation on this machine (6e-17 at most for exp)). Outputs closed/open/street are the function result; convective (climate.convective_tendency of the latitude in degrees), cold (the cold-air ramp smoothstep(0, 8, |back lat| - |lat|) in degrees) and total_raw (closed + open + street before the normalization, which divides by it where it exceeds 1) are intermediates, there to localize a mismatch; they share the tolerance. params.constants holds the knees and weights written in the code.
